ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels. Dark pixels dominate the central and proximal regions, while white pixels are concentrated in the distal lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the outer 25-30% of each lobe's distal margin. The left lobe exhibits a larger white patch with internal black mottling. The right lobe has a slightly smaller, more defined white patch at the tip. The central fluke area is a solid low-intensity black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 50-60 degrees, centered at the convergence of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of variations is higher on the left lobe, featuring several distinct 'U' and 'V' shaped indentations (valleys) against the dark pixel background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory along the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the distal tips (lobes).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels located at the extreme outer dorsal corners of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear marks. Left lobe: 3-4 diagonal white scratches crossing from the dark central area into the white distal patch. Right lobe: two prominent horizontal white linear disruptions in the dark central area and one diagonal mark in the white distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent 'rake marks' or linear scars (likely orca-induced or substrate abrasions) visible as white pixel lines contrasting against the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive black mottling/spots (low-intensity islands) located within the high-intensity white regions at the lateral tips of both lobes.
